definitions.gloss: here and there; in places; in some parts
definitions.explanation: Scattered in various locations, not uniformly distributed. Indicates partial or sporadic occurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所々|ところどころ}⟦{剥|は}げている→禿げる：20344_hageru⟧。
examples.english: The wall is peeling here and there.

examples.japanese: {所々|ところどころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{所々|ところどころ}⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are mistakes in places throughout the text.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所々|ところどころ}⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}めなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The road was under construction in places, so I couldn't make much progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所々|ところどころ}⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{色|いろ}づいて→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: When autumn comes, the mountains turn red here and there and look beautiful.

notes:
WRITING: Also written as {処々|ところどころ} or in hiragana.

USAGE: Describes something that appears irregularly or in scattered locations, not everywhere but in various spots.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {所々|ところどころ}に (in various places)
- {所々|ところどころ} + verb/adjective (here and there)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧ (here and there - more random)
- ⟦{方々|ほうぼう}→方々：00116_houbou⟧ (all around, everywhere)
- ⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧と (dotted here and there)

NOTE: The reduplication emphasizes the scattered, sporadic nature.
